Check hf does not like tese filter names http.http2_settings_uri, I do not know how to work around that. The current status is that it does not dissect the trace in the issue correctly.
It looks like 3 zero octets are missing, not sure if it's the code or the base64uri encoded
data that is wrong. Perhaps add a TRY/CATCH call around the usage of the http2 decoder.
I guess it would make sense to create a subtree
